_about: The global-indices map (Global Indices, work in progress, IDX-2, 2026-10-08). Every value was read twice, independently, from the pinned official files (tools/sources.json, globalIndices) and the two readings compared (tools/.cache/indices/idx2/diff.md); a mismatch in a stored field holds an item out. Open rankings keep every country's rank and value; facts-only rankings (restricted licences) keep only Bangladesh's rank of N, the top and the bottom. User-input rankings wait for the user, who reads their official pages by hand (their terms forbid automated access, or robots.txt bars us). Built by tools/build-global-indices.mjs. Every Bengali string awaits the user's approval; country names reused from the basemap are its pinned names.
decisions: Tabs Countries and Bangladesh only; no Cities tab (the user, 2026-10-08).
Open rankings shade every country; facts-only rankings store and show Bangladesh, the top and the bottom only; Dhaka's liveability is a row in the Bangladesh tab (the user, 2026-10-08).
Population: the 2026 medium-variant projection of WPP 2024, labelled as a projection; population and density ranked among the 193 UN members; WPP 2024 counts as current (the user, 2026-10-08).
Ranks computed from official values (population, density, remittances, FDI) are labelled as sorted by value; MPI shows its value only (the user, 2026-10-08).
For a ranking computed from one release (population, density, remittances, FDI), "previous" is the year before in the same release (the assistant's reading of the brief; for the user to confirm).
The South Asia position = position among the eight SAARC countries (the user, 2026-10-08).
Countries with no shape in the Bangladesh-view file (Israel, Taiwan, …) are listed, never shaded (the user, 2026-10-08).
CRI: the long-term ranking (1995–2024 in CRI 2026) is shown; the single-year one is in the readings (the assistant's choice, for the user).
